note: Based on the original description of Kemner (1932) (in German); only the soldier is described, the alate being given in the original as Imago: unbekannt. Measurements taken from the tables of the original (Körperlänge, Kopf mit/ohne Oberkiefer, Kopfbreite, pronotum width and length); the digits are damaged in the OCR, corrected where the context allowed and omitted where illegible. German terms are given in full (Kopfbreite = head width, Pronotum = pronotum).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Ground colour yellow-white, head reddish brown, slightly darker in front. Head shape quadrilateral-oval, slightly narrowed anteriorly, widest in the posterior quarter. Frons with a shallow groove. Right mandible with two triangular teeth, the two separated by a horn-like notch. Left mandible with the two outermost teeth large, the third almost indiscernible, teeth 4 and 5 nearly equal in size. Antenna 13—14 segments, segment 3 markedly large and dark, longer and stouter than segments 2 and 4. Pronotum wider than the head. The species is close to N. saleierensis, from which it differs in the more oval head shape and the mandibular dentition; the large third antennal segment recalls the genus Kalotermes in the strict sense, but whether it belongs to that genus can only be decided once the alate is discovered, since the genus characters lie in the alate.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm): body length 8.00—10.00; head with mandibles 4.00—5.00; head without mandibles 2.50—3.08; head width 2.05—2.33; pronotum width 2.15—2.30; pronotum length 0.85—1.01. The alate is recorded in the original as Imago: unbekannt (unknown). Workers are represented only by nymphs of different sizes. Type locality: Poeloe Ketela on Djampea Island (between Celebes and Flores), 1920-12-29, living in a piece of tree trunk.
